text:
Ava (CS): Quick heads-up — we have an evening hands-on session tomorrow 7:00pm PT for the Zephyr trial cohort. I’m scheduled to lead but there’s a conflict. Can someone cover or swap? Link to prework: https://rwd.co/zephyr-prework :spiral_calendar: 

Ravi - Enablement: I can probably take it if someone can hand me the facilitator notes. What’s the attendee count?

Ava (CS): 18 signed up (mostly devs + 2 execs). Agenda is lean — quick onboarding + 30m guided lab + 15m Q&A. Notes live in the shared doc: https://rwd.co/zephyr-notes

Elise (Ops): I can cover the first 40 mins (intros + lab kickstart) but need the lab VM URL and deck. Can you drop those in the doc by EOD?

Miguel (AM): Heads-up — two of the execs are renewal-risk flagged (usage low). If we can make the Q&A focused on production rollout blockers, that might help conversion. Could we add a 5-min segment on entitlements & dedicated capacity?

Samira (CSM): +1 to Miguel. Quick poll: keep original lab-heavy agenda or pivot to rollout-focused Q&A? React with :lab_coat: for lab-first, :chart_with_upwards_trend: for rollout-first.

Ava (CS): Good point. I’ll update the doc with a 5-min 'entitlements & next steps' slide. @Ravi if you take it, please emphasize infra/perf stuff for the execs.

Ravi - Enablement: I’ll take it. Can someone add the VM link and the quick runbook here? small snippet works.

Elise (Ops): Pasted the VM + runbook in the doc. Also added a one-slide punchlist for entitlements.

calendar-bot: Event updated: "Zephyr: Evening hands-on (Facilitator: Ravi)" — tomorrow 7:00pm PT — guests: 18 — conference: Zoom.

Ava (CS): Fantastic, thanks all. Final agenda (short):
```
- 0–10m: Intros & goals (Elise)
- 10–40m: Guided lab (Ravi)
- 40–45m: Entitlements & next steps (Ava)
- 45–60m: Targeted Q&A (team) — emphasize prod rollout blockers
```

Ava (CS): If anyone wants to rehearse 15m before, ping me. Otherwise I’ll update the CS notes and send a reminder to the attendees 2h before. :thumbsup: 

Miguel (AM): Thanks team — I’ll follow up with the two execs pre-session to surface the rollout questions.

Samira (CSM): Quick feedback capture plan: will send the post-session form and tag renewal-risk accounts so we can route follow-up.

Ravi - Enablement: Got it, I’ll skim the notes tonight. See you all tomorrow.

Elise (Ops): :thumbsup:
